description: B11完成后的B12输入 - Runtime/Adapter所需Permission合同

permissionContractForB12.description: B12 Android/iOS/Desktop RuntimeAdapter需要集成的Kernel Permission合同
permissionContractForB12.adapterPermissionCheckPattern: Adapter.Execute() → ctx.Subject = SubjectForExtension(extID) → broker.Evaluate(ctx, req) → if Decision != Allow → return ErrPermissionDenied

scopeContractForB12.adapterShouldUse: ScopeExtension (for adapter self) + ScopeModule (for module-level isolation)

approvalContractForB12.adapterShouldHonor: DefaultApproval from PermissionDefinition (ApprovalManual for high-risk, ApprovalAuto for read-only)

existingPermissionSystemReference: B12应直接使用existing backend/internal/extension/kernel/permission/体系，不新建任何Permission Registry/Broker/Store
